entries.en: Welcome back, Research Assistant Elizabeth Baynham. What can I do for you?
Fetching data. The previous user was attempting to access details on the study of Subject Species 37, the Thorian.
Aside from lacking proper access, there has been no new data available on Species 37.
The Thorian is a simple plant life-form that exhibits a sentient behavior uncommon with other flora.
Through dispersion and the eventual inhalation of spores, it can infect and control other organisms, including humans.
The Zhu's Hope control group has yielded interesting results. Before sensors went offline, almost 85% of all test subjects were infected.
Your access card identifies you as Elizabeth Baynham.
Is there something you require, Dr. Baynham?
Species 37 was discovered several weeks ago when a small team was infected with spores while examining ruins near the Zhu's Hope outpost.
Within 21 days, 58% of colonists exhibited altered behavior. Within 28 days, 85%.
The will-subversion manifests as intense pain if directives are ignored. The effect is severe enough that subjects are soon conditioned against even minor thoughts of rebellion.
Observation suggests the Thorian views its thralls in a utilitarian way. Care is apparently taken to avoid injuring them, much as a craftsman avoids damaging his tools.
As long as no action is taken against the creature's objectives, the subjects are free to pantomime a normal existence until specifically tasked with something.
The Thorian appears to be a diffused creature. Its cognitive abilities are centered in large nerve bundles, but it receives data from kilometers of meandering tendrils.
We have discovered bundles approximately one meter in diameter, but these seem insufficient to coordinate the massive sensory potential it possesses.
It may simply process such stimulation slowly, or perhaps there is a nerve cluster of a greater magnitude we have not yet encountered.
The Thorian is present as a weave of tendrils across much of the lower surface of Feros.
Observation of enslaved subjects suggests there may be key clusters that are tended by thralls.
Unfortunately, direct observation of Species 37 is limited or non-existent.
The Thorian does not exhibit the focused behavior of a predator. The release of spores is an act of survival, not aggression.
It does trigger advanced behaviors in the humans it enslaves, but we have yet to discover whether it recognizes--or is capable of recognizing--humans as more than tools.
It is sufficiently alien as to defy classification at this time.
I have no specifics on the geth as they relate to this facility. All sensors have been purposely decommissioned since their arrival.
ExoGeni Corporation is at the forefront of human expansion in the new galactic economy, funding colonial development and securing resource rights to ensure our progress as a species.
Further inquiries regarding company policy may be directed to Consumer Information Services during regular business hours.
All decisions about local resource analysis and acquisition are made by onsite management, deferring to the board of directors only when seasonal quotas are missed or exceeded.
Individual employee records are confidential.
Elizabeth Baynham, Research Assistant, Bio-Medical Division. Security Level 4 exemption.
You are currently under probation due to disagreements with management over established company policy. These sanctions may be lifted if your next evaluation is more agreeable.
You were marked as "combative" about the operations of the Zhu's Hope project, specifically regarding the handling of the infected colonists.
As a result, you were tasked with monitoring the safety of the colonists for the duration of the observation.
What information was the last user attempting to access?
What did you tell him?
Uh, how do you know I'm Lizbeth?
Tell me about the Thorian.
Do you know how the creature controls its slaves?
What is the size of this thing?
Where is the center of this thing?
Is it intelligent? Can I reason with it?
What do you know about the geth?
I want to know about ExoGeni Corporation.
Who is in charge here? Who organized the research?
Please access "my" personal files.
What triggered the probation?
That's enough for now.
What did the krogan want?
Lizbeth?
Lizbeth
How does it control people?
How big is it?
Where can I find it?
How smart is it?
Who runs this facility?
Why was "I" sanctioned?
Going to standby mode.
Species 37 is located within the substructure of the Zhu's Hope outpost.
It was deemed necessary to assess the true potential of Species 37.
That explains their strange behavior.
So that's why they were acting weird.
That's why they were acting so strange.
No wonder they were behaving so strangely.
It's no wonder they were behaving so oddly.
We should contact Joker.
Your pilot should be warned.
You should contact Joker.
We should warn Joker.
Should we inform your pilot?
We've got to drop that shield and get back to the outpost.
We must find a way around the field. We must get back to Zhu's Hope.
We need to drop that field and get back to Zhu's Hope.
We need to get that field down so we can get out of here and back to Zhu's Hope.
I have limited data on the geth. They have effectively blocked all sensors within the facility.
I have detected unusual power fluctuations, but am unable to determine the source.
The outpost was quarantined immediately and study of the infection began.
What does Zhu's Hope have to do with the Thorian?
Tell me everything you know about the Thorian.
Are you saying ExoGeni knew its people were getting infected?
ExoGeni knew all along what would happen to those people.
Joker. Come in, Joker. Damn it. That field's blocking us.
VI, what can you tell me about the geth ship and the field it's generating?
VI, tell me about the field surrounding the facility.
We need to find that ship. Let's get moving.
Zhu's Hope?
What did you say?
This is what Saren wants.
Control group?
You bastards.
It couldn't hurt.
Tell me about the field.
I was unable to provide the previous user with any relevant data.
All sensors monitoring the observation post at Zhu's Hope have been inactive for several cycles.
Tell me everything you told the krogan.
Then we do it the hard way.
Fine. We're on our own.
This structure seems to have significance for the geth. Is it possible they set up this room to serve as a sacred temple of sorts?
What is this place? Almost looks like the geth built themselves some kind of church.
This place seems almost peaceful. Do you think the geth were using this room as some kind of religious temple?
The layout of this room reminds me of the temples my people used to build. Do you think the geth were using it for religious services?
Hey, if they're looking for God, I'd be happy to speed them on their way.
The geth blur the line between organic and synthetic life. It's natural to assume they seek understanding from a higher power.
Whatever. I ain't here to learn their customs.
You think the geth come here to pray? Do synthetics even believe in God?
The geth certainly aren't subtle. How do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
They appear to have grappled through some sort of containment lab.
Seems like a containment lab of sorts, Commander.
Maybe we can swat it off. One of these claws has to have a weak spot.
Perhaps it can be dislodged. One of the other claws may have a weakness we have yet to detect.
Could the ship be dislodged? Maybe there's a flaw in one of the other claws we could exploit.
We need a way to give it a kick. Let's check the other claws. Damned things can't be perfect.
It will be difficult. We can check the other claws for weaknesses, but the geth are very thorough.
Subtle as a boot to the face. How do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
Indelicate, perhaps, but very efficient. How do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
The geth don't waste much finessing their landings. How do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
I like their docking style, but how do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
Same as before. We don't have the ordnance to blow this claw. Let's keep looking.
Just like the other one. We don't have the teeth to tear this out. Keep looking.
I fear we do not have the needed gear to destroy this claw. We will have to keep looking.
This claw is identical to the last. We'll have to keep going.
This is interesting, Shepard. A containment lab of some kind.
We find a way to break even one claw and that ship is out of here.
Whatever. We just need to find a way to break even one claw and that ship is out of here.
It is an asset we lacked at the other claws. Dislodge even one claw and that ship will fall.
It may be helpful. If we can dislodge even one claw the ship may fall.
It's no armory, but tear up even one claw and that ship is gone.
What do you make of this, Commander? Looks like a containment lab.
What is this, Commander? A containment lab?
Not much force across the whole system. Is there some way to isolate it on a single door?
Pretty weak across the whole system. Any way to isolate it on a single door?
Weak as hell across the whole system. Can we isolate it on a single door?
Force is dissipated across the whole system. Perhaps it can be concentrated?
It seems that force is dissipated across the system. Perhaps there is a way to isolate it?
Very good! The field barring the exit will be down. Now we can go deal with this Thorian creature.
All right! The door out will be open now. We can head back and deal with this Thorian thing.
That's the way. Doors will be open now. We can go deal with that Thorian thing.
Well done! Our way out should be clear now. We can go address this Thorian issue.
Exceptional, Commander! The fields will be down. We can go deal with this Thorian creature now.
The geth use these claws to anchor their ships to the sides of buildings.
Looks like they're using these claws to anchor that ship to the side of the building.
The geth must have anchored their ship to the side of the building with these claws.
It appears the geth are using these claws to anchor their ship to the side of the building.
The geth have anchored their ship to the building with these claws.
This was my kind of mission. Kill a bunch of geth, and end things off with a huge crash!
Damn. I'd like to have seen the face on their pilot when that thing toppled.
I hope that ship was full of those geth bastards!
Well. That got the job done.
Keep your guard up. There still might be a few geth inside the base.
I repeat, Normandy to shore party. Are you reading? Anyone there? Normandy to shore party. Come on, Commander, talk to me!
We're in lockdown here, Commander. Something happened to the colonists. They're banging on the hull, trying to claw their way inside the ship. They're freaking out!
Uh... yeah. Okay. Well, we'll just wait right here for you, Commander.
Uh... will do, Commander. We'll fire off a few warning shots. That should send them running.
